hypothesis: The default locking provider is in-memory, so the lock that serializes stock reservation only exists inside one Medusa process. With two servers on one database, two carts that each need the single SOLO unit can both pass the stock check and both reserve it, overselling SOLO (stock 1) and possibly leaving reserved_quantity inconsistent. I expect no_oversell to fail in some runs when the completions are released together across servers.

description: Two carts each hold one SOLO unit, completed at the same time on two servers sharing one database. Stock is 1.

  engine: medusa
  version: 2.22.0
  servers: 2

  SOLO: 1

  alice:
    server: 1

      qty: 1
  bob:

    lines:
    - sku: OVS-SOLO
      qty: 1

  server: 1
  do: complete
  cart: alice

  server: 2
  do: complete
  cart: bob

  jitter_ms:
  - 0
  - 3

I expect no_oversell to fail if the availability check does not add up lines that share an item.
